title: Agents
subtitle: List of A2A-spec agents that are available to be used in your organization. Go to AI Hub, to make agents public.
why_keys_desc: Keys scope access to an agent and allow it to call MCP tools. Assign a key when creating an agent or from the Virtual Keys page.
search_placeholder: Search agents by name, ID, or description...
adjust_search: Adjust the search to see more agents.
add_agent_cta: Add an agent to make it available in your organization.
delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete agent: {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.

create_modal.title: Add New Agent
create_modal.agent_type_hint: Select the type of agent you want to create
create_modal.custom_desc: For agents that don't follow a standard protocol, just needs a virtual key
create_modal.assign_team_hint: Optionally assign this agent to a team. The agent and its key will belong to the selected team.
create_modal.create_new_key: Create a new key for this agent
create_modal.create_new_key_desc: A dedicated key scoped to this agent.
create_modal.assign_existing_key_desc: Re-assign a key you already have to this agent.
create_modal.skip_key: Skip for now — I'll assign a key later
create_modal.require_trace_inbound: Require x-litellm-trace-id on calls TO this agent
create_modal.require_trace_inbound_desc: Only accept this agent being invoked with a trace-id (e.g. when used as a sub-agent).
create_modal.require_trace_outbound: Require x-litellm-trace-id on calls BY this agent
create_modal.require_trace_outbound_desc: Requires LLM/MCP calls made by this agent to include x-litellm-trace-id for session tracking.
create_modal.enable_trace_outbound_warning: Enable "Require x-litellm-trace-id on calls BY this agent" in Tracing to configure budgets and rate limits.
create_modal.max_iterations_desc: Hard cap on LLM calls per session
create_modal.max_budget_desc: Max spend per trace before returning 429
create_modal.agent_rate_limits_desc: Global rate limits applied across all callers of this agent.
create_modal.per_session_rate_limits_desc: Rate limits per session (x-litellm-trace-id). Each session gets its own counters.
create_modal.guardrails_desc: Apply guardrails to this agent. Selected guardrails will run on all calls made by this agent.
create_modal.key_assigned_notice: Key {{alias}} has been assigned to this agent.
create_modal.no_key_assigned: No key assigned. You can create one from the Virtual Keys page.
create_modal.entitlements_desc: Configure which models, agents, and MCP tools this agent is allowed to use. Leave fields empty to allow all (subject to key/team permissions).
create_modal.allowed_models_hint: Restrict which models this agent can call. Leave empty to allow all.
create_modal.allowed_agents_hint: Restrict which other agents this agent can invoke as sub-agents. Leave empty to allow all.
create_modal.allowed_mcp_servers_hint: Select which MCP servers or access groups this agent can access
create_modal.select_mcp_placeholder: Select MCP servers or access groups (optional)
create_modal.select_existing_key_error: Please select an existing key to assign

virtual_keys.title: Virtual Keys
virtual_keys.no_keys: No virtual key assigned to this agent.
